summary: This is a JSON object describing a superhero team called the Super hero squad, including basic information about the organization like when it was formed and where it's based, plus a detailed list of three member heroes with their personal details and special abilities.

explanations.4: This is the year the squad was founded, stored as a number rather than text.
explanations.6: This boolean flag indicates whether the squad is currently active (true means yes, they're still operating).
explanations.7: This is an array (a list) that will contain multiple hero objects; the square bracket means we're about to list items.
explanations.12: This is an array of text strings listing all the superpowers that this character possesses.
explanations.26: This character's age is one million, which is the dataset's humorous way of indicating an extremely old or immortal being.
